description: This Java source file defines the ProductDBUtil class, which provides database utility methods for managing products in an online grocery ordering system. It includes methods for retrieving, inserting, updating, deleting, and associating products with sales and employees, interacting directly with the database via SQL queries.
external_files: //Assumed external database utility class providing executeSearch, executeIUD, and getConnection methods

classes.name: ProductDBUtil
classes.description: A utility class for performing CRUD operations and associating products with sales in the database.

methods.name: getAllProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products from the database and returns them as a list of Product objects.

methods.name: insertProduct
methods.description: Inserts a new product into the database and associates it with an employee, returning success status.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing product in the database by its ID.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Deletes a product from the database by its ID.

methods.name: getProductById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific product by its ID.

methods.name: createProductSale
methods.description: Associates a list of cart products with a sale, inserting records into Product_Sale and updating product quantities.
